arguments.silver_model: the kept silver model's name, passed to ref()
arguments.surrogate_keys: mapping of <dimension>_sk to {'dimension': ..., 'natural_key': ...}, as in this contract

fact_macro.output: every silver column unchanged, then one <dimension>_sk per mapping, using the unknown member for a null or unmatched natural key

publish.backup_prefix_note: Owner decision of Oct 13 2026: one catalog backup per publish run under this prefix, named catalog_backup_<run ID>.json. Owner decision 5 allows S3 writes under it.

rules.columns: Every silver column lands once, under its silver name; no value is stored twice (failure mode 744). Controls appear only in bridge_measure_control.
rules.grain: A fact's rows equal its silver model's rows; grain test on the silver unique key; rows and content fingerprint equal the silver model's over the silver columns (gold failure mode 743).
rules.lineage: Facts read only their kept silver model, their dimensions and lookup seeds; a dimension or bridge reads only the inputs this contract lists for it, lookup seeds and gold models (failure mode 746; amendment A37).
rules.surrogate_keys: <dimension>_sk = md5 of the natural key's text in the dimension; a null or unmatched natural key takes the unknown member (failure mode 745).
rules.unknown_member: Each dimension has one row with natural key '<unknown>' and <dimension>_sk = md5('<unknown>'); the one exception is dim_date, whose unknown row has a null calendar_date (amendment A40); facts never carry a null foreign key.
